name: simple-hack
description: Hackathons, now for everyone. Run an event, build a team site with AI, join and judge on Simple Hack.

interface.longDescription:
Hackathons, now for everyone. No coding needed: describe your idea and your AI builds your team’s site. The best idea wins, not the best coder. For college students, product managers, leaders and people who aren’t programmers.

Plan and run a hackathon on simple-hack.app with five role-focused skills. Organisers create an event, configure registration and judging, publish a custom event website and icon, manage teams, and publish results. Participants join with a code, form teams, submit an entry and vote. Judges open project sites, score the rubric and manage conflicts. Website Deploy Builder helps plan a team project, and Website Deploy publishes its static site and configures KV, SQLite or file resources.

All five skills require the signed-in Simple Hack connector. The skills-only package declares that tool dependency in each skill; the full package also includes an MCP manifest. The same connection works across event roles and can select the person's current team for site publishing. Public event JSON supports a custom page while joining, team work, judging and management stay on the trusted apex.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a draft hackathon and publish its event website
Show my hackathon events and the stage of each one
I am judging a hackathon; show my projects and scoring rubric

publication.release_notes: Hackathons, now for everyone. Participant skills build the team’s idea for them, with no coding needed. Connector permissions and event operations are unchanged.
